info.title: Multi-App Game Platform — Phase A Contract Candidate
info.description: Implemented public sandbox contract for 11 competitive games plus thunder/tiger. Production runtime is isolated and admission remains closed pending real partner acceptance. Probability math profiles are sandbox candidates. Per-path servers distinguish PlatformAPI from PartnerWallet/PartnerEvents; .invalid URLs remain non-live placeholders. Read wallet-protocol.md, integration-guide.md and production-handoff.md for transaction and deployment boundaries. OpenAPI alone does not establish accounting atomicity, fairness or production acceptance.

post.summary: Create a sandbox one-time launch code
post.description: Implemented for sandbox partner HMAC integration. In production this signed endpoint always rejects with 403 PLAYER_BFF_REQUIRED, including resume attempts: an App signature does not authenticate a player. Production launch and recovery use only the platform-owned same-origin /api/player/launch BFF after platform login. Production admission is currently disabled; no hosted login/return page is available for third-party sites. Persistent launch intents return their original code/expiry on an authorized replay.

post.description: PHASE A DESIGN CONTRACT; NOT IMPLEMENTED OR DEPLOYED. Notifications may repeat/arrive late/out of order; never perform money movement. Signed request_id equals event_id and remains stable for retries; operation_id references the original wallet command and is not this notification ID. 204.description: Atomically persisted notification; duplicates also acknowledge.

Identifier.description: Opaque case-sensitive identifier; never infer identity or authority from its shape.

AmountMinor.description: Non-negative integer decimal string in configured currency minor units; range 0..9223372036854775807 inclusive. No floating point, exponent or leading zeros. Use integer arithmetic for all calculations.

Scope.description: Credential-bound partner/app/environment; mismatches rejected, not overridden by request body. All monetary resources also bind wallet_scope_id and currency_id.

MoneyBalance.description: Available excludes holds; snapshots are not authorization to debit.

CompetitiveTerms.description: Immutable economic/rule terms, stored at first reserve and compared by typed field values on every reserve and capture. App allowlist and game mode constrain player_count/team_size; 2v2 requires four players. fee_bps templates require App authorization; default 500 is 5%.

seat_index.description: Randomly allocated and frozen before admission/first reserve, unique and contiguous 0..player_count-1 within a match. Tied prize remainders go only to eligible winners in ascending seat_index; never decide a winner by user ID or seat.

Must equal the captured immutable seat. Equal-rank prize remainder is allocated in ascending captured seat_index after equal base shares; ordering only allocates minor-unit remainder, never breaks ranking ties.

rank.description: Required for completed matches; omitted for void refunds with no valid ranking.

seat_index.description: Randomly allocated and frozen before admission/first reserve, unique and contiguous 0..player_count-1 within a match. Tied prize remainders go only to eligible winners in ascending seat_index; never decide a winner by user ID or seat.

WalletMatch.description: CANCELLED may exist before any reserve and therefore has no terms or participants. It is a durable match tombstone. After capture the roster and terms are immutable.

ProbabilityAuthorization.description: AUTHORIZE freezes stake and the full maximum gross payout liability atomically. ACCEPTED has no automatic expiry. Pre-authorization CANCELLED tombstones may omit financial fields. Authorized records must include all game/math/stake/liability fields; see wallet-protocol.md.

Operation.description: Durable operation for one of the eight wallet financial command kinds. For these commands only, operation_id equals request_id and the command deduplication key is (partner_id, app_id, environment, request_id). Event notifications use an independent namespace: their request_id equals event_id while operation_id references this original command. UNKNOWN is a caller-local observation, never a terminal state. Success requires receipt; rejection requires rejection. Platform query is a reconciled mirror; wallet query is authoritative.

seat_index.description: Randomly allocated and frozen before admission/first reserve, unique and contiguous 0..player_count-1 within a match. Tied prize remainders go only to eligible winners in ascending seat_index; never decide a winner by user ID or seat.

ReserveRequest.description: Atomic reserve; amount must equal terms.entry_minor, seat < player_count; same user/seat reserved once per match. expires_at is server-validated, at most 120 seconds after request acceptance. Check match cancellation tombstone before freezing.

CaptureMatchRequest.description: All-or-none capture under match/hold transaction locks. Count equals terms.player_count; users, seat indices, reservation IDs unique. Every referenced hold belongs to this match/scope, is RESERVED, unexpired, and matches user/amount/terms. No gameplay before confirmed success.

ReleaseMatchRequest.description: Close the entire not-yet-captured match and release ALL reservations atomically. Persist a cancellation tombstone even if none arrived. Late reserves/captures must reject. If already captured reject ALREADY_CAPTURED; use void settlement after state recovery.

SettleMatchRequest.description: Atomic all-participant credit + fee. Include losers with zero payout. Completed: sum(payouts)+fee=captured; fee=floor(total*locked_fee_bps/10000), prize template and ranks must agree. Void: refund each original entry, fee=0, reason required. Cannot overwrite a terminal result. Payout users/seat indices must each be unique and cover exactly the captured roster; invalid or missing participants reject the whole transaction. Equal-rank payouts use equal base shares and distribute remaining minor units to eligible winners in ascending immutable seat_index, allocated randomly before admission/first reserve. No separate settlement-order field; never rank by user ID or seat.

AuthorizeProbabilityRequest.description: Atomically hold player stake plus full paid-cycle gross payout liability in separately configured reserve account. math profile/hash/cap must be approved for this App. Cap includes every retrigger/free spin. Wallet rejects capacity before ACCEPT/RNG, never after outcome selection. expiry at most 60 seconds; expires only before ACCEPT.

AcceptProbabilityRequest.description: Atomic acceptance fence. Check AUTHORIZED and not expired/cancelled; transform holds into non-expiring accepted liability. Only confirmed success permits server RNG/result fixing. Same cycle accepted once; accepted responsibility survives configuration/budget changes.

CancelProbabilityRequest.description: Before ACCEPT only; atomic cancel + release. Persist cycle/authorization tombstones even if authorize has not arrived. Late authorize/accept reject. Already ACCEPTED returns ALREADY_ACCEPTED; no outcome-conditioned cancellation.

SettleProbabilityRequest.description: After confirmed ACCEPT and one persisted complete paid-cycle result, atomically debit held stake, credit gross payout, update reserve account and release unused liability. Gross payout includes stake return and <= authorized cap. Validate immutable math/stake/profile; payout cannot be denied for newly reduced available budget. Retries never reroll.

resume_session_id.description: Optional reauthorization/reattachment target. In sandbox the partner backend authenticates the App user; in production only the platform player BFF reauthenticates the same platform player. Scope, player and game binding are checked before token rotation. Existing accepted obligations can resume after new-session admission closes.

host_origin.description: Exact registered host origin, e.g. https://community.example. Omit for the platform console origin. Bound to each one-time launch code.

CreateSessionRequest.description: Sandbox partner HMAC request only. The partner derives external_user_id from its authenticated App user. In production this endpoint returns 403 PLAYER_BFF_REQUIRED; /api/player/launch derives a stable App-scoped external_user_id from the platform player record, and never accepts a browser-supplied ID. The lobby is not currently released; specify a released game_id.

launch_code.description: Opaque high-entropy single-use code; never log/store long-term.

entry_url.description: Registered HTTPS entry URL without secret query parameters.

CreateSessionResponse.description: Replay of same idempotent create intent returns original code and expiry, not a refreshed code. If expired, create a new launch intent with new request_id. For an authorized resume intent, session_id is the existing bound session; expiry is only for launch code, not an instruction to cancel active game obligations.

host_origin.description: Actual MessageEvent.origin observed by the platform game bridge. Required for an external host.

game_id.description: Game page identity checked before the one-time code is consumed.
Game page identity checked before the one-time code is consumed.

ExchangeLaunchResponse.description: Token only for the game session; it grants no wallet API permission. In sandbox the partner backend may reauthenticate and request a resume code. In production the platform player BFF verifies the HttpOnly login session and original player/App/game binding before issuing a resume code. Exchange rotates the token generation and preserves the accepted match, seat and cycle.

MathProfile.description: Target RTP is versioned metadata, not an editable probability override. Only published verified profiles are eligible; exact capped liability derived from approved stake/profile.

CatalogResponse.description: Only credential-authorized games for this App. A listed conceptual game is not evidence of implementation or deployment.

PlatformMatch.description: Scope-filtered support/status view. Does not return opponents' private cards, unrevealed RNG seeds, credentials, or arbitrary internal account details.

request_id.description: Equals event_id and signed X-GP-Request-Id, stable for notification retries. Not the original command request_id.

event_id.description: Unique notification ID in independent (partner_id, app_id, environment, event_id) inbox namespace. Same ID with a different original body must reject.

operation_id.description: References the original wallet financial command operation_id. Multiple distinct events may reference this operation; it does not have to equal this event_id or request_id.

PartnerEvent.description: Notification only. Signed request_id equals event_id; operation_id references the original financial command and is independent. Persist/deduplicate (partner_id, app_id, environment, event_id) in a separate inbox before 204; same event ID with different original body rejects. Ignore stale aggregate versions and query authoritative API when needed. Never create a new money operation, debit or credit in response to an event.

KeyId.name: X-GP-Key-Id
KeyId.description: Credential identifies partner/app/environment/direction, never supplied by browser.

Timestamp.name: X-GP-Timestamp
Timestamp.description: Unix seconds; absolute clock skew <= 300 seconds.

Nonce.name: X-GP-Nonce
Nonce.description: 128-bit fresh random nonce, persisted per key at least 610 seconds.

RequestId.name: X-GP-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Stable request business ID. Equals body request_id on writes. For eight wallet commands this is operation_id; for event notifications this is event_id, while body operation_id references the original command. New nonce/timestamp on retry, unchanged body.

BadRequest.description: Malformed or inconsistent request; do not retry a modified business operation under the same ID.

Unauthorized.description: Missing/invalid signature, timestamp/nonce replay, or consumed/expired launch code.

Forbidden.description: Scope mismatch, credential direction mismatch or game entitlement denied.

NotFound.description: No visible record now. Does not prove a delayed operation will not arrive.

Conflict.description: Persistent idempotency conflict, cancelled tombstone, invalid state, expired hold or already accepted/captured.

Unprocessable.description: Insufficient player balance or new probability liability capacity, before game acceptance only.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit; preserve business ID and honor Retry-After.

Unavailable.description: Outcome may be UNKNOWN. Query original operation ID and reconcile; do not create a new financial intent.

HmacSignature.name: X-GP-Signature
HmacSignature.description: Custom gp-hmac-v1: v1=<HMAC-SHA256 lowercase hex>, with required Key-Id, Direction, Timestamp, Nonce, Request-Id headers. Canonical 9 LF-separated lines, no trailing LF; see integration-guide.md and signature-vector.json. API key declaration documents transport location; this is not a static token.

externalDocs.description: OpenAPI 3.1 normative specification (this API remains design only)

x-security-invariants: Idempotency and ledger effects share one persistent transaction.
Unknown results require original-ID lookup; cancellation tombstones fence delayed commands.
Capture and settlement atomically cover all participants.
Probability acceptance freezes non-expiring full-cycle liability before RNG.
No cash withdrawals or cross-App/currency pools in V1.
